Learn more Best for a home office Learn more Next Play Indicator 1 Close Close Close Close Close Close Frequently Asked Question What does a monitor do and what are the types of monitors? Monitors display the visuals from your computer, enhancing your experience across various tasks. The types of monitors you can choose from vary by usage. Gaming Monitors : Designed for gamers, these monitors offer high refresh rates (120Hz, 144Hz, 240Hz, etc) for smooth visuals and low response times* (1ms, 0.1ms, 0.03ms, etc) to minimize delay. Technologies like G-Sync and FreeSync prevent screen tearing and stuttering. Not sure what the best gaming monitor is for you? Find out more information about Samsung gaming monitors . Ultrawide Monitors : With a wider aspect ratio (21:9 or 32:9), ultrawide monitors provide more screen space for multitasking, gaming, and movies, creating a more immersive experience. Curved Monitors : Curved screens offer a natural viewing experience by reducing eye strain and providing an immersive display. Ideal for gaming, movies, and professional tasks, they make the screen edges more consistent with your field of view. High-resolution Monitors : Monitors with resolutions like 4K or 5K UHD provide sharp, detailed images, perfect for graphic design, video editing, and photography. Smart monitor : Offer advanced features like internet connectivity, built-in streaming services, voice command support, and IoT integration for enhanced convenience and productivity.** *Response time may vary by model and measurement method. ** Access to the full range of smart features requires a Samsung Account. How do you measure a computer monitor screen size and, what size do I need? The size of a computer monitor is typically measured in inches, denoted by quotation marks ("), such as 24" , 27" , 32" , and so forth. This measurement is taken from one corner to another along the diagonal of the screen. When selecting a monitor size, it's crucial to consider its intended use, whether for gaming, work, watching content, etc. For instance, some gamers often prefer larger monitor sizes depending on what games they enjoy, ranging from 34" to 49" , even 57" with ultrawide displays for a more immersive gaming experience. Your viewing distance from the monitor and available desk space are also important factors. If space is limited, opting for a smaller monitor, around 24" or 27", is advisable to ensure comfortable usage within confined areas. What is screen resolution, and what should my screen resolution be? Screen resolution refers to the number of pixels displayed on a screen, typically described in terms of width and height. Higher resolutions mean more pixels and sharper, clearer images. Full HD (1920x1080) is a popular choice for general usage like web browsing and multimedia consumption. QHD (2560x1440) offers higher resolution, providing sharper images and more screen real estate, suitable for tasks like content creation and gaming. 4K UHD (3840x2160) provides the ultimate in detail and clarity, delivering stunning visuals and crisp graphics, especially for professionals working with high-resolution content and enjoying content with more vivid, lifelike visuals. Ultimately, the best resolution for you depends on factors like the size of your screen, the distance from which you'll be viewing it, and the tasks you'll be performing most frequently. Do computer monitors have speakers? Not all monitors come with built-in speakers. It often depends on the manufacturer and the specific model. These monitors with speakers keep your desk clean from the mess of wires and external speakers while ensuring you can listen to any content with ease. If audio is a critical factor for your setup - for instance, in professional video editing - you may want to check the specifications of the range of our monitors you are interested in at Samsung UK. What is the refresh rate on a monitor and how many HZ should a monitor have? The refresh rate of a monitor indicates how many times per second it can draw a new image, measured in Hertz (Hz). For instance, a 144Hz monitor updates the image 144 times per second, offering smoother visuals than standard 60Hz displays. While high-end options like 240Hz monitors exist, choosing the right refresh rate depends on individual needs and preferences. For general tasks like document editing or web browsing, a 60Hz or 75Hz monitor suffices, while experienced gamers may prefer 144Hz or more for smoother gameplay. Competitive gamers, or e-athletes, often opt for 240Hz monitors for the highest level of performance. Ultimately, the ideal refresh rate for a monitor should match the user's computer performance capabilities and gaming requirements, ensuring smooth and immersive visual experiences. Are curved monitors better? Curved monitors offer advantages for specific use cases, but whether they are "better" depends on individual preferences and intended usage. Curved screens can enhance immersion and provide a more natural viewing experience by reducing distortion at the edges and creating a sense of depth. This is particularly beneficial for gaming and multimedia consumption, offering a wider field of view and a more immersive feel. Workers and professionals also benefit from curved monitors, as the screen wraps around the user, widening the field of view, helping to stay focused, enhancing productivity, and reducing eye strain. You can shop all Samsung curved monitors at Samsung UK. What is an IPS and VA monitor, and which one should I choose, VA vs IPS? An IPS (In-Plane Switching) monitor is a type of display panel known for its excellent color accuracy, wide viewing angles, and consistent brightness levels compared to VA Panels. IPS monitors are ideal for tasks like photo editing, graphic design, and content creation, where color accuracy is crucial. VA (Vertical Alignment)panels are a type of display technology known for providing deeper blacks and better contrast ratios. These panels are preferable for tasks like watching movies or gaming, where image depth and contrast are important. Ultimately, the choice between an IPS monitor and a VA monitor depends on your priorities. You can shop all Samsung IPS monitors at Samsung UK. What is an HDR monitor, and what are its benefits? An HDR (High Dynamic Range) monitor enhances contrast, brightness, and color accuracy, providing vibrant and lifelike visuals. By supporting HDR technology, these monitors can display a wider range of colors and luminance levels, resulting in stunning image quality. HDR content such as movies, games, and multimedia benefits from enhanced realism and depth, making every scene more immersive. Overall, an HDR monitor is ideal for users seeking superior image quality and an immersive viewing and gaming experience. Can I connect a monitor via USB-C? Yes, you can connect usb-c to your monitor. The USB-C port is versatile and supports a variety of functions, including video output. However, the ports are different for each monitor. Some displays have HDMI, some have DisplayPort, and some have USB-C ports. Make sure you have a USB-C cable that is compatible with the port on your display. Then connect one end of the USB-C cable to your device and the other end to your display. When connecting a USB-C device to a monitor, make sure both the device and monitor support the required protocol, such as DisplayPort over USB-C. Overall, using a USB-C connection to your monitor increases simplicity, versatility, and convenience, streamlining your workspace setup. While it retains the 200MP main camera, 12MP ultrawide, and a 10MP telephoto with 3x optical zoom from its predecessor, a significant change is the replacement of the 10x telephoto with a new 50MP 5x telephoto lens. This might seem like a downgrade, but the new sensor is larger and has a wider aperture, resulting in better image quality, particularly in low light. It also includes a versatile camera system with a 50MP Wide camera, 12MP Ultra Wide camera, 8MP Telephoto camera with 3x optical zoom and 12MP Selfie camera. • Galaxy S26 FE supports a range of Galaxy AI features, including My FanCam, bringing many of the latest Galaxy AI experiences to the device. • Galaxy S26 FE features a 6.7-inch display and a 4900 mAh (typical) battery, matching Galaxy S26+ in screen size and battery capacity. • Galaxy S26 FE is a great next step for users looking to move up from the Galaxy A series to the Galaxy S series, bringing together advanced camera features, Galaxy AI experiences and premium everyday essentials in one device. *Measured diagonally, Galaxy S26 FE's screen size is 6.7"" (171.1 mm) in the full rectangle and 6.6"" (166.4 mm) accounting for the rounded corners. Galaxy S26 and S26+ offer various upgrades that set them apart from the previous Galaxy S25 and S25+ models, which include: • A new ambient island camera design for a sleeker, more premium look. • An AI image signal processor (ISP) in the front camera for more natural, realistic selfies. • Super Steady with Horizontal Lock, a video shooting feature that allows for smoother, shake-free videos* by keeping your shots level even if you rotate a full 360°. • A redesigned Vapor Chamber that spreads heat more evenly within the device for up to 29% greater thermal performance, allowing your phone to stay cooler for longer. • New AI features designed to intuitively fit into your life and simplify your everyday experiences. *Results may vary depending on light condition, subject and/or shooting conditions. Q. What are the colour options for Galaxy S26, S26+ and Galaxy S26 FE? Click to Expand A. What are the available storage options for Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7? Click to Expand A. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7 comes with three storage options of 256 GB, 512 GB and 1 TB. If you're unsure of which storage option to get, consider your lifestyle and how much storage you typically use on your phone. You can get an idea of your usage by checking the storage capacity on your current device, which is typically found in the settings. Here, you can see how much space is being taken up and even get a breakdown of the different categories, like photos, videos, apps, music, documents and more. If you don't think you'll be creating or downloading much content, then you can stick to a similar storage size to what you already have, or just choose the lowest available option of 256 GB. However, if you take a lot of pictures and videos or download a lot of games and apps, then consider choosing the storage option of 512 GB. This should ideally give you the space to add new content to your phone while keeping the photos, videos, music and other files you already have. If you're going to be dealing with a lot of data — whether for work or gaming — consider upgrading all the way to 1 TB. This storage variant for Galaxy Z Fold7 was created for power users who require a lot of space for large files and high-performance tasks. You can check out available storage options and deals here. Q. Can I trade in my current phone when I buy the new Samsung phone, and what do I get for it? Click to Expand A. Got an old device you want to Trade In? Samsung makes it easy. Just answer a few questions online and you can find out what your device is worth, immediately. You'll get instant discount for the Trade-In value of your device. Samsung.com will take it off your hands, even if your screen is cracked or it's not a Samsung device. Q. What is Samsung Care+, and how can I get it for my Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7? Click to Expand A. Enjoy peace of mind with Samsung Care+. You’ll stay worry-free, with protection from accidental damage and breakage for up to 2 years. Whatever happens, our Samsung trained technicians will work to help get you back on track, using only Samsung genuine parts, to keep your device working like new. Q. What are the benefits of using other Samsung products with my Samsung Galaxy phone? Click to Expand A. You can enjoy the benefits of a seamless ecosystem when you use Samsung products together, as they’re designed to work with each other for an enhanced user experience. Your Galaxy smartphone can pair with other Samsung products like Galaxy Buds, Galaxy Watch, Galaxy Tab and Galaxy Book for smooth cross-device functionality. Samsung Galaxy devices can detect each other to effortlessly connect and interact in various ways. They can sync notes and data, shares files, mirror screens and much more. Plus, being part of the Galaxy ecosystem also makes your phone better for work and productivity, as it enables more functions for multitasking and communication between devices. For example, you can copy something from your Galaxy phone, then paste it directly onto your compatible Galaxy Book or Tab. Or you can drag and drop items between different devices, almost like it’s one big extended workspace. Special discounts may be available when you buy eligible Galaxy products together, so you can save when you build your multi-device ecosystem. Bundle your phone purchase with Galaxy Buds, Galaxy Watch and more to unlock the full potential of what you can do with Samsung Galaxy. For detailed information, please check https://www.samsung.com/connected-experience/ Q. Does Galaxy Z Fold7 come with a charger? Click to Expand A. No, Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7 does not come with a charger, though it does come with an ejection pin and data cable included in the box. The ejection pin can be used for SIM card removal, while the data cable can be used to connect your phone to other devices for various tasks, including an adapter for charging. However, the actual adapter or charger has to be purchased separately. We recommend using a Samsung charger with your Galaxy Z Fold7, as our chargers are designed for safe and optimal use with Samsung Galaxy devices. Click to Expand Galaxy Z Fold8 introduces a brand-new form factor to Samsung Galaxy's lineup of foldable phones, featuring a lightweight design and optimised screens for content viewing while also offering long-lasting performance, advanced photography and AI features. ● Designed with an all-new shape, the cover screen’s 10:16 aspect ratio is perfect for scrolling while you get your daily dose of inspiration from social media. ● Unfolded, the 4:3 wide screen is best for when you want to engage deeper and watch your favorite movie or get immersed in a TV series. ● At just 201 grams in weight, Galaxy Z Fold8 is our lightest Fold yet. ● The camera system features a dual 50 MP Wide and Ultra Wide camera for seamless shots from wide to ultra-wide without losing quality. ● The powerful Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy processor is customised especially for Galaxy with advanced NPU, GPU and CPU for smoother graphics. ● The smoother Armor FlexHinge and a widened gap of the inner bezel result in a more effortless opening. ● A dual layer of titanium has been applied to the shock-absorbing layer underneath the display, strengthening the screen. What makes Galaxy Z Fold8 so different from Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and Galaxy Z Flip8? Click to Expand Galaxy Z Fold8 introduces a unique design with an all-new shape for Galaxy foldables, optimised for viewing different types of content. ● Galaxy Z Fold8 features an all-new foldable form factor designed for content viewing, with optimised aspect ratios on both screens. You can switch between short-form content and long-form content with ease on the same phone. ● The 5.5-inch cover screen is designed for quickly scrolling and viewing social media, while the 7.6-inch main screen is perfect for when you want to immerse yourself deeply in a movie, TV series or e-book. ● In addition, Galaxy Z Fold8 is our lightest Fold yet at just 201 grams in weight. ● Meanwhile, Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is an ultra-powerful foldable smartphone with a design and performance suited for working, immersive gaming and performing side-by-side tasks. Galaxy Z Flip8 is a foldable phone that folds shut into a more compact form, perfect for slipping into your pocket. What are the colour options for Galaxy Z Fold8? Click to Expand Galaxy Z Fold8 colours come in three standard options of Lavender, Graphite and Cream, and one exclusive colour option of Pistachio that's available only on Samsung.com and in Samsung Experience Stores. ● Galaxy Z Fold8 colours come in three standard options of Lavender, Graphite and Cream, and one exclusive colour option of Pistachio that's available only on Samsung.com and in Samsung Experience Stores. ● Pistachio is the exclusive colour option for Galaxy Z Fold8 that is available for purchase only on Samsung.com and in Samsung Experience Stores. What are the available storage options for Galaxy Z Fold8? Click to Expand Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 has three storage options available: 1 TB, 512 GB and 256 GB. You should choose the storage option that best suits your lifestyle and demands, such as whether you need to save a lot of pictures and videos or download various apps and games. ● 1 TB (with 16 GB of memory): If you're going to be dealing with a lot of data, consider upgrading all the way to 1 TB. This is the perfect storage option for power users who need a lot of space for large files and high-performance tasks, particularly for work or gaming. ● 512 GB (with 12 GB of memory): If you take a lot of pictures and videos or download various apps and games, then consider choosing the 512 GB storage option. This should ideally give you the space to add new content to your phone while keeping the photos, videos, music and other files you already have. ● 256 GB (with 12 GB of memory): If you take a moderate number of pictures and videos and don’t download many apps or games, then the right choice may be the 256 GB storage option. ● If you’re still unsure of which option is best for you, check the storage capacity on your current phone (usually found in the settings) to get an idea of your typical usage. You can see how much space is being taken up and even get a breakdown of the different categories, like photos, videos, apps, music, documents and more. This will give you a good idea of how much storage you will need on your new device. What are the benefits of buying my Galaxy Z Fold8 from Samsung.com? What is Samsung Care+ and how does it work? Samsung Care+ is Samsung’s insurance service that covers unlimited accidental damage for Samsung Galaxy smartphones, tablets, wearables and laptops - with the option to add loss and theft cover. You can choose Monthly Pay or pay upfront but either way you have the flexibility to cancel cover at any time. Find out about Samsung Care+ and how to add cover for your device. Is Samsung Care+ available in all European markets Samsung Care+ is available in many European markets. Please check your local Samsung website for availability and terms. What devices can be covered by Samsung Care+? Samsung Care+ is available for selected Samsung devices, including: Galaxy S Series smartphones Galaxy Z Series smartphones Galaxy A Series smartphones Galaxy tablets Galaxy Watches Galaxy Books Other models may be eligible outside Europe. What does Samsung Care+ cover? Samsung Care+ includes worldwide cover for: Unlimited Samsung certified repairs for screen damage and other damage (including liquid) Mechanical or electrical breakdown after the manufacturer’s warranty Battery replacement at no extra charge if capacity is under 80% Walk-in or send-in repair with priority service For extra peace of mind, Samsung Care+ with loss & theft is available, which covers up to 2 replacements in any 12 months if your device is lost or stolen. Does Samsung Care+ cover cracked screens? Yes. Samsung Care+ covers accidental screen damage, including cracked or shattered screens, subject to the terms, conditions, and excess fee payable for your device, in your country. There is no limit on the number of claims you can make for unlimited damage. Does Samsung Care+ cover water or liquid damage? Yes. Samsung Care+ covers water and liquid damage, subject to the terms, conditions, and excess fee payable for your device, in your country. There is no limit on the number of claims you can make for unlimited damage. Does Samsung Care+ cover lost or stolen devices? Samsung Care+ with Theft & Loss covers lost or stolen devices. It is available for smartphones, tablets and watches, but not laptops. Claims are subject to the terms, conditions, and excess fee payable for your device, in your country. You can make up to 2 claims in any 12-month period for loss and theft of your device. You must activate Knox Guard within 30 days of buying Samsung Care+ with Theft & Loss for a mobile or tablet, otherwise cover will be cancelled. Knox Guard is only used to block your device once a claim is accepted to protect your data and prevent fraudulent use. How much does Samsung Care+ cost in Europe? Samsung Care+ pricing varies based on: Your Samsung Galaxy Model The cover you have selected (Samsung Care+ or Samsung Care+ with Theft & Loss) The Plan you have selected (Monthly Plan or 2 Year Plan) You can check the premium and excess fee for your device on samsung.com. Does Samsung Care+ use genuine manufacturer parts and authorised repairs? Yes. All Samsung Care+ repairs use original Samsung parts and are carried out in Samsung Authorised Service Centres. Will my device Warranty still be valid after I make a claim? Yes. If your device is still within its original warranty period, a repair under Samsung Care+ will not invalidate that warranty. Can I buy Samsung Care+ after purchasing my device? Yes. You can add Samsung Care+ when buying your device from Samsung.com or a Samsung Experience Store or within 60 days of buying an eligible device from Samsung or one of our operator, retailer or online partners (via Settings on your Samsung Galaxy smartphone or tablet, or via samsung.com for any eligible device). How do I check if I have Samsung Care+? To check your cover, cancel cover and make a claim: Log into your Samsung account at samsung.com Go to uk.careplus.co Call +44 204 623 8217 How do I make a Samsung Care+ claim? You can complete a claim in minutes online at: uk.careplus.co Please have a debit or credit card ready to pay the excess fee. Once your claim is approved, please follow the instructions provided for the repair or replacement of your device. You can also call +44 204 623 8217 How long does a Samsung Care+ repair take? Repair times may vary by country and whether you choose walk-in or send-in repair service. Repairs may be completed same day in our walk-in repair locations, but send-in repair takes a little longer. We aim to repair and return your device within 3-5 days. We will update you throughout the repair process so you know what’s happening and when your device is ready for collection / on its way back to you. Will I receive a replacement device? If your device is lost, stolen or we cannot repair it, then we will replace it, subject to the terms, conditions, and excess fee payable for your device. Replacement devices may come from Samsung refurbished stock. Is there an excess fee or service fee for Samsung Care+ claims? You have to pay an excess fee to complete an approved claim for repair or replacement of your device. You can check the excess fee for your device at samsung.com. Can I cancel Samsung Care+? You can cancel Samsung Care+ at any time online or by phone. For Monthly Plans, cover will finish at the end of the paid month. For 2 Year Plan, refunds are based on the time since purchase and whether any claim has been completed. You can find details at samsung.com and in your terms and conditions. Can Samsung Care+ be transferred to a new device? Samsung Care+ is linked to your device and cannot be transferred to any other person or device. How do I know if I need it? The decision to take cover needs to be based on your individual circumstances and needs. Consider how you use your device, if you prefer a predictable cost of repair or are worried about the risk of having to pay to repair or replace a damaged device. You should also check if you’re already covered by another policy (like home insurance or with your bank account). Whatever your decision, check the cover and terms to make sure you have what you need. If you add Samsung Care+ and change your mind, you can cancel cover within the first 30 days and you will receive a full refund of any premium paid (provided you haven’t completed a claim in that time). What’s the difference between Samsung’s warranty and Samsung Care+? When you buy your device, it comes with a standard manufacturer warranty that covers you in the event of electrical or mechanical breakdown in the warranty period. Samsung Care+ covers your device for unlimited repairs for accidental damage and breakdown after the manufacturer warranty period, (and loss & theft if added). Close Close Expand FAQ Click to Expand Q. What comes in the box with Galaxy Tab S11 Series? Does it come with an S Pen? Click to Expand A. When you unbox your new Galaxy Tab S11 or Tab S11 Ultra, you’ll find an S Pen for precise note-taking and creative tasks, a quick start guide to get you set up, an ejection pin for the SIM/microSD tray, and a USB Type-C data cable for charging and connecting. *Travel Adapter is NOT included. Q. What is the difference between Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 and Tab S11 Ultra? Click to Expand A. The Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra takes all the same great features as the Tab S11, such as the slim build, powerful processor, incredible display and groundbreaking Galaxy AI features and enhances the experience even further. The Tab S11 Ultra features a larger 14.6-inch display, an additional rear camera in the form of a 8MP Ultra Wide and a longer lasting 11,600mAh battery. Q. What storage options are available for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 series? Click to Expand A. Galaxy Tab S11 Series offers a range of memory and storage combinations to suit your needs. Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra is available in 16 GB + 1 TB, 12 GB + 512 GB, or 12 GB + 256 GB. Galaxy Tab S11 is available in 12 GB + 512 GB, 12 GB + 256 GB, or 12 GB + 128 GB. If you need more space, both samsung tablets support microSD card (sold separately), so you can easily expand your storage for apps, class notes, creative projects, or media. *Actual storage availability may vary depending on pre-installed software. *MicroSD card sold separately. All models support microSD cards with up to 2 TB storage. External memory can be used to store media (photos, video and music files). Availability may vary by country and manufacturer. Q. What colours are available for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Series? Click to Expand A. The Galaxy Tab S11 Series are available in two colours, Grey and Silver. Q. Does the Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 series support wireless charging? Click to Expand A. No, the Galaxy Tab S11 Series doesn't support wireless charging, however it supports up to 45W fast charging via USB-C.* *45W charger sold separatley Q. Is the Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 water-resistant? Click to Expand A. Yes, the Galaxy Tab S11 Series feature an IP68 rating which means they are dustproof and water resistant.* *Based on lab test conditions for submersion in up to 1.5 metres of freshwater for up to 30 minutes. Not advised for beach or pool use. Q. Does the Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 support multitasking? Click to Expand A. Built for the modern multi-tasker, the Galaxy Tab S11 and Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra helps you stay organised. These versatile tablets are designed to handle work, study, and entertainment. Both models come with an S Pen to take notes, sketch, or solve math problems easily. Galaxy Tab S11 features a compact 11.0-inch display, measures 253.8 × 165.3 × 5.5 mm, and weighs around 469 g, while Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra offers an expansive 14.6-inch display, measures 326.3 × 208.5 × 5.1 mm, and weighs around 692 g. Both are great for reading, attending online classes, or streaming content. With long battery life and smooth performance, both are great choices for everyday tasks and relaxation. Q. Is the Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 good for gaming? Click to Expand A. Yes, from super slim bezels to upgraded brightness, Tab S11’s 11-inch and Tab S11 Ultra’s 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X displays deliver incredibly immersive visuals. From streaming to gaming, experience next-level entertainment like never before. Q. Does Galaxy Tab S11 Series support an S Pen and accessories like a keyboard? Click to Expand A. Yes, Galaxy Tab S11 supports both S Pen and Book Cover Keyboard Slim accessories. S Pen is included in the box and allows for precise writing, sketching, and note-taking. Pair your samsung tablet with Book Cover Keyboard Slim that turns it into a work-ready setup. For added versatility and protection, you can use Book Cover which offers flexible viewing angles, and Anti-Reflecting Screen Protector which helps reduce glare. *Accessories sold separately. Q. Why should I switch to Galaxy Tab S11 Series? Click to Expand A. If you want Galaxy's most powerful tablet experience with AI built for real productivity, Galaxy Tab S11 Series is the one to choose. Its ultra-slim design packs next-level performance and a massive display that's still easy to carry. Galaxy AI supports your day with multi-modal intelligence, helping you undestand content, stay organized, and create faster across apps. Plus, the new DeX offers a more intuitive experience for multitasking, so you can work smarter anytime, anywhere. Q. How many any Android OS upgrades does Galaxy Tab S11 Series get? Click to Expand A. Galaxy Tab S11 Series is eligible for up to 7 generations of Android OS upgrades, along with 7 years of security updates from the date of global launch. This long-term software support helps keep your tablet secure, up to date, and compatible with the latest features over time. *Availability and timing of Android OS upgrades and security updates may vary by device model and market. Q. Can I transfer my data from iOS? Click to Expand A. Yes, you can quickly and easily transfer your iOS data to Galaxy Tab S11 Series using Smart Switch. Smart Switch is a tool that simplifies transferring data from one device to another by allowing you to seamlessly move contacts, photos, videos, notes, calendar events and more. You can connect your new Galaxy Tab S11 Series to your old device using a cable or wirelessly using the Smart Switch app. *Wired transfers from iOS require the receiving device to have Android™ 5.0 or later and the sending device to have iOS 5 or later. Transfers can be completed without a cable through a wireless connection or iCloud. For wireless connections, the receiving device must have Android™ 5.0 or later and the sending device must have iOS 12 or later. iCloud transfers require the receiving device to have Android™ 5.0 or later and the sending device to have iOS 5 or later. It seems odd to me that the most recent A Series tab, (the A9 8.7" Tab), which is the in a sense the 'starter tab' from the Samsung brand, includes more performance, memory, and features than this "want-to-be" professional device, all the while at less than half the price. Overall, this terrible tablet has seriously dented my confidence in the Samsung brand,’ making me wonder why on earth they have ‘conned’ professional users to invest in this dreadful product? From my perspective, the Tab Active5 is absolute rubbish and a complete waste of money! Do I recommend the Galaxy Active5? Absolutely not! HDR, HDR10, HDR10+, what does this actually mean? Let's delve into the details behind these terms and explore the transformative benefits of HDR technology. What does HDR mean on a TV? HDR TV technology enhances contrast and color for a more realistic picture by increasing the difference between darks and whites, offering formats like HDR10, Dolby Vision, and HLG. HDR10 is the original and most common variation of HDR that you might come across. If manufacturers want to associate this term with a TV, it means that the TV must reach a certain standard based on colour subsampling, bit depth and other factors… To put it simply, the TV has to produce a certain standard of picture quality and this is measured against a variety of criteria. What is HDR10? HDR10 is a common variation of HDR that you can find on Full HD, 4K and even 8K TVs. HDR10 involves static metadata which is designed to improve picture quality using encoded information. This clever HDR technology adjusts the light levels to produce images that have greater levels of contrast and a wider colour gamut compared to standard TVs, making images look more realistic and true-to-life. What is HDR10+? Samsung pioneered HDR10+ technology, setting a new standard for HDR. HDR10+ is used across Samsung TV ranges and serves up a glorious viewing experience. HDR10+ uses dynamic metadata (rather than static metadata with HDR10) to further improve the brightness levels and colour depths you see on your TV. This results in TV content that looks incredible whatever you're watching, day and night. The latest Neo QLED TVs take HDR10+ even further with Samsung’s next generation Quantum HDR. This cutting-edge technology boasts an exquisite level of detail. Capturing the subtlest of details in both bright and dark areas to produce true HDR10+ picture quality exactly as the director intended. You can find the exceptional Quantum HDR64X on Samsung’s flagship QN900B Neo QLED 8K Smart TV . Does HDR make a difference? Yes! HDR introduces a wider range of colours and brightness levels compared to Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) by telling the TV exactly which colours to display at the correct level of brightness. SDR by contrast only has a limited range of brightness and colours so images tend to be duller and less sharp. Here’s why we would always recommend a HDR10+ TV: • Images appear more life-like with exceptional levels of contrast • Brightness levels adapt to what you’re watching • Higher levels of peak brightness • Wide colour gamut resulting in deeper, richer colours • Clearer details in dark areas • The latest TV content is optimised for HDR Do all 4K TVs have HDR? Yes, all Samsung 4K TVs benefit from HDR technology. However, 4K TVs from different TV brands might not necessarily have HDR included since they are in fact two different display technologies - you can therefore have one without the other. HDR optimises the contrast - giving the picture greater vibrancy, brightness and depth, whilst 4K is responsible for how detailed the image you see on the screen is. Together they create breath-taking images that look true-to-life. For the best TV picture quality you should opt for a TV with both 4K (or indeed 8K ) and HDR10+. Due to HDR’s ability to create high contrast between light and dark areas on screen, HDR technology is perfect for gaming. Particularly for gamers who enjoy playing warzone, exploration or high intensity games on a console or PC. Looking for the best TV for gaming? Check out the Samsung Neo QLED 4K HDR Smart TV for immersive, game-changing action on the big screen: Discover Samsung’s range of Gaming TVs or learn more about how to pick the best gaming TV for you . How to choose HDR TV? If you want to experience your favourite films and shows with life-like accuracy and colour depth, then a Samsung TV with HDR10+ capability is a great place to start. Since 2020 the Frame , Serif and Terrace Outdoor TV have had HDR10+ support but all new Samsung TVs now benefit from HDR10+ as standard. Of course there’s more to consider than just HDR. There’s also the design and size of TV to best suit your home. High quality sound will also ensure you’re getting the best home cinema experience available, consider features such as 3D Object Tracking Sound+ (OTS+) or adding a Samsung Soundbar to take TV audio to the next level. You can find out more about choosing your next TV, by visiting the Samsung TV Buying Guide . What is the best HDR TV? Now we know how HDR works and everything it does to deliver startling picture quality, this ground-breaking technology can be considered alongside other features so that you can find the best TV that is HDR capable. Whether you’re interested in the innovative features found across the Samsung Lifestyle TV Ranges or maybe you’d prefer an awesome 8K giant in the Neo QLED range , finding the best HDR TV is no problem with Samsung. Looking for one of our best? Check out the QN80H Neo QLED 4K Smart TV with a crisp picture and dynamic sound. It delivers one of the best viewing experiences available with HDR10+ Advanced today. There's no more struggling to make out what's happening on the big screen thanks to remarkable HDR brightness that brings rich blacks, bright lights and deep contrasts. And with Samsung's Vision AI Companion, every frame is optimised to perfection - intelligently analysing your content in real time - so you can enjoy exceptional detail in everything you watch. Learn more about 8K TV and 8K resolution with our helpful article here. HDR TV FAQs Do all Samsung TVs have HDR? All 2016 and newer Samsung 4K TVs have HDR10+ capabilities. Since 2020 the Frame , Serif and Terrace Outdoor TV have also had HDR10+ support. You can find a full list of Samsung HDR10+ certified TVs here . What does HDR stand for? HDR stands for High Dynamic Range and is a technology on your Samsung TV which improves the brightness, richness and clarity of the colours you see on the screen. It’s responsible for the true-to-life colours and stunning imagery you see on the TV. Is HDR TV better than LED? HDR (High Dynamic Range) and LED (Light Emitting Diode) are two different types of display technology, both of which can be found on one TV. LED simply refers to how the backlight of your TV display is made. Virtually every flat screen TV today uses LEDs as its source of backlighting. However, there are differences in the number and quality of LEDs used across different TV brands. Samsung TVs use Quantum dots to achieve an even greater level of brightness and colour clarity but fundamentally they are a type of LED. HDR technology increases the contrast and brightness even further, so you experience only the brightest whites and darkest blacks. LED TVs particularly benefit from HDR because it improves the overall contrast ratio of the TV, making the darkest part of the image perfectly black which in turn enhances the brightness of the images you see on the screen making them come alive with a much wider colour gamut. Want to know what a QLED TV is, how it works, and if you should choose one for your home? We’ll tell you everything you need to know. QLED TV: Quick Takeaways ● QLED is different to conventional LED TVs thanks for Quantum Dot technology . ● Their high brightness and anti-glare screens keep everything clear, even in daylight. ● Quantum Dot technology delivers rich, accurate colours at any brightness. ● Samsung QLED AI-powered processors enhance everything you watch to near-4K or 8K quality. What is QLED technology? QLED TVs use quantum dots for enhanced brightness and color, making them great for bright rooms, but they don't have OLED's perfect black levels. Previous Next Close What’s a Quantum dot in QLED TVs? Quantum dots are manufactured nanocrystals that consist of ultra-fine semiconductor materials. The purpose of a quantum dot is to produce different colours of light depending on the size of the particle at that very moment. A larger particle will skew towards appearing as a red colour and the smaller the particle the more blue it will appear. Quantum dots are able to emit precise coloured light because particle sizes adjust at quantum-level velocities, resulting in accurate and efficient light emissions. This is the main reason why QLED technology is synonymous with tremendous improvements in overall picture quality. What is a Quantum Processor? A Quantum processor uses machine learning and AI to upscale lower definition picture content to 4K or 8K quality, giving a greatly enhanced viewing experience. The Quantum processor allows for even more precise control over backlight dimming, greater distribution of brightness and a boost to black detail. This means that the brighter parts of the TV are even brighter, whilst the darker areas of the screen are able to display greater details, giving improved visibility at both ends of the spectrum. Want to learn more about TV screen resolution? Visit our helpful buying guide articles to learn more about 4K TVs and 4K TV resolution . What's special about QLED TVs? QLED TVs take advantage of the many unique characteristics that Quantum dots offer such as "high luminance". Luminance refers to how bright a screen looks and that brightness is an important factor affecting other elements of image quality. First, the contrast ratio is naturally improved when brightness is higher. When bright and dark representations of videos and images can be widely expressed, it's known as HDR (high dynamic range) . This HDR, which is an essential component of picture quality, is enhanced further providing crisp and rich images. The effect of brightness on overall colour quality is simple. For example in the red colour spectrum there is a range of bright and dark reds, but QLED TVs express this range of colours better. This unique QLED technology, along with other black implementation technologies such as Direct Full Array, provides stand-out picture quality. What is a QLED TV best for? Whether you’re keen to catch up on shows in brightly lit rooms or you want to ensure your living room decor isn’t dominated by a bulky set, QLED TVs are the answer. Your TV Habit What You Need Why QLED? Daytime TV Bingers A TV I can watch in sunlit rooms without loss of detail High brightness, Anti-glare screen, HDR Cinema-Lovers at Home Immersive visuals and sound for true at-home cinema vibes Quantum Dot colours, HDR contrast, Q-Series Soundbar Living Room Gamers Playing fast-paced, visually demanding games Low latency mode, high colour accuracy, 4K upscaling Design-Conscious Watchers Sleek, slim profile for modern interiors AirSlim design, minimal bezel, aesthetic fit Discover how Samsung AI brings QLED picture quality to life. Learn how AI optimises colour and contrast. Learn more What is the difference between OLED and QLED? While QLED TVs are ideal for bright and colourful displays, OLED TVs shine in creating immersive, cinematic experiences with rich contrasts. QLED TVs excel in delivering exceptional brightness and vibrant colours, making them perfect for bright rooms or daytime viewing. On the other hand, OLED TVs stand out with their ability to produce deep, true blacks and high contrast, offering stunning picture clarity in dark environments. Learn more about the differences between QLED, OLED & LED in our guide. What is the best QLED TV? Our top-of-the-range QLED TV is the 65” QN900D Flagship Neo QLED 8K HDR Smart TV with the highest density of Quantum Mini LEDs it creates the most detailed TV picture yet. Each QLED is controlled with intense precision to create inky blacks and exceptional levels of contrast, to achieve the highest levels of brightness. This top model also offers the finest 8K picture quality for a fully immersive and cinematic viewing experience. Featuring Samsung’s most intelligent processor to date, it automatically learns scene-by-scene to optimise the brightness, amplify the contrast and enhance objects to their best. Plus, it upscales the resolution to incredible 8K even if it wasn’t filmed that way. With edge-to-edge cinematic viewing, Dolby Atmos sound and pro Quantum Matrix technology, it’s the ultimate Samsung QLED TV. To achieve the greatest viewing and listening experience, our QLED TVs go hand-in-hand with Samsung Q-Series Soundbar . The elevated cinematic surround sound will place you in the heart of the action as you will hear the sound coming from every direction when connecting a soundbar to your Samsung TV . Equipped with Amazon Alexa voice assistant, it really is a great amalgamation of smart technology and entertainment at its core. For more information about Samsung’s top QLED TVs check out our Samsung Neo QLED TV page . 1 Upscaling enhances picture quality but results may vary depending on the source content. 2 Alexa functionality requires internet connection and compatible device. Features subject to change. FAQs Is QLED better than OLED? Whether a QLED TV is better for your home viewing experience entirely depends on your environment - it will depend on what you value. Whereas OLED TVs typically portray better true blacks and offer better wide-angle viewing, QLED models can provide higher brightness levels for daytime viewing. You should do research into your needs before choosing the best TV for you. How new is QLED technology? QLED was introduced by Samsung in 2017. Do QLED TVs work well in bright rooms? QLED TVs are a strong choice for viewing in bright rooms as they combine very high brightness, strong colour at high light levels, and anti-glare screen coating. Are QLED TVs energy efficient? Yes, because QLED TVs use an LED backlight behind an LCD panel, so they don’t use power to light every pixel individually like some other TV technologies 3 . 3 Energy consumption varies by model and usage - check the product specification for the energy rating of individual TVs.
